cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

mechanism: A controls a station lift with a petrol price and a growing demand for reciprocal contact, allowing quiet travel while raising the emotional cost of deferral.
confusable: Simple transactional bargaining lacks a distinct emotional price that changes when the practical offer returns.
comparison: Dress alternative ties money to recognition of taste rather than initiative in a damaged relationship.
seedUse: Lift seed supplies petrol and stopped calls; S02 adjusts when the conversation happens to preserve B cooperation without dropping its escalating relational price.
